Food Processing | Santosh Magnetic Works
Iron out of the food, records for the audit
Metal is one of the most common causes of food recalls. It arrives with flour, sugar, grain and spices, and it comes off sieves, mills, mixers and pumps as they wear.

Our separators take it out at intake, after each stage that sheds metal, and before packing. All food contact parts are 304 stainless steel. Rods up to 13,500 gauss hold fine particles and work hardened stainless steel. Every unit comes with a tested certificate of magnetic strength, which is the document an auditor asks for.

Oil and Gas | Santosh Magnetic Works
Black powder out of the pipeline

Black powder is fine iron sulphide and iron oxide formed by corrosion inside steel pipelines. It narrows the pipe, wears compressors, pumps and valves, gives false meter readings and blocks barrier filters that then have to be replaced and disposed of as hazardous waste.
Because it is an iron compound, a magnet holds it. Our inline and modular pipeline filters take it out of the flow at full pressure. The cores are lifted out and cleaned. Nothing is consumed.

Pharmaceuticals | Santosh Magnetic Works
Clean product, clean records
Pharmaceutical lines handle powders, granules, tablets and liquids where any metal is a serious defect. Iron arrives with raw materials and comes off mills, blenders and tablet presses as they wear.

Our separators are made in polished 304 stainless steel with rods up to 13,500 gauss. They hold fine particles and work hardened stainless steel. Every unit is supplied with a tested certificate of magnetic strength, and a gauss meter lets you re-check it for your validation records.

Steel Processing and Handling | Santosh Magnetic Works
Lift it, hold it, keep the fluid clean

Steel plants and stockholders handle heavy plate and bar all day. A permanent magnetic lifter moves a plate with one person and no slings. A magnetic chuck holds a part for grinding or turning with no clamps in the way.

Rolling, sawing, quenching, threading and washing all put fine steel into the process fluid. A magnetic filter takes it out at full flow with no consumables. Magnetic sweepers clear swarf and offcuts from the floor.

Virgin and Recycled Plastic Processing | Santosh Magnetic Works
Protect the machine and the product
A nail or a screw in a granulate feed can score a screw, block a nozzle or break a grinder blade. Fine iron in the melt ends up in the moulded part. Recycled material carries more of both.

Our separators take out the large pieces at intake and the fine particles before the machine. Plate and chute magnets handle the coarse tramp iron. Grids, drawer housings and bullet magnets take the fine iron from the granulate feed.

Magnetic Filters | Santosh Magnetic Works
Overview
Clean fluid without consumables

Fine steel particles in a coolant, oil or wash liquid score slideways, block nozzles, wear pumps and spoil the surface finish. A barrier filter catches them only if its pores are small enough, and then it blocks.

A magnetic filter works by attraction. The fluid passes over high strength neodymium rods and the iron holds to them. Particles of any size are removed at full flow. Nothing is consumed. Cleaning is a wipe of the rods.
We build the range to order at our works in Mumbai, with the connection size and magnetic strength matched to your line. Every unit comes with a tested certificate of magnetic strength.
Filtration range
Where a magnetic filter pays for itself
Grinding and machining coolant lasts longer and the finish improves. Hydraulic and gear oil carries less wear metal, so the machine wears less. Wash tanks stop redepositing iron on the next batch.
Most contamination in a metalworking fluid is iron. Put the magnetic filter first and a coarser barrier filter after it, and the barrier filter lasts many times longer.
